svg.title: Minglora Gifters Level Up — Correct Coin Requirements
svg.desc: All 50 Gifter levels and their exact cumulative Coins required, from Level 1 at 1 Coin to Level 50 at 97,500,000 Coins. Only successfully confirmed gifts sent count.
svg.text: 1 CONFIRMED COIN SPENT ON A GIFT = 1 GIFTER PROGRESS POINT
Only successfully confirmed gifts sent count. • LV 25 unlocks the special LIVE entrance badge.
